values.meaning: duration of the Mounting Dread mark
number of stacks (basic attacks) needed to detonate Mounting Dread
values.binNote: The wiki text says the mark stacks up to 3 times and the third stack triggers the pounce ('the third stack directs Wolf to pounce'), but KindredEWrapper.StacksToProc = 4 in the bin. Recording the wiki's stated value of 3; this is a genuine discrepancy.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks against the marked target each apply a stack, refreshing the mark's duration, up to the stack cap; reaching the cap consumes all stacks and triggers the bonus pounce damage.
mechanics.quote: Her {{tip|basic attacks}} against the marked target each apply a {{tip|stack}}, refreshing the duration and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: This ability cannot be recast on a target that already has Mounting Dread stacks (only used to apply the initial mark and slow).
mechanics.quote: This ability cannot target a unit with ''Mounting Dread'' stacks.

mechanics.claim: If the target dies, becomes untargetable, or leaves range/sight during the cast time, the ability cancels, does not pay its cost, but still goes on cooldown.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time, this ability will cancel and not pay its cost but still go on {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: The pounce damage is further increased by up to 50% based on Kindred's critical strike chance and critical damage.
The missing-health portion of the pounce damage is capped against monsters, not against champions.
mechanics.quote: The damage based on the {{as|'''missing''' health}} ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
